tools.name: fleet_cancel_email_draft
tools.description: Cancel an unsent native email draft when the user asks to discard or revise it. Pass its approvalId as callId. Never cancels an email that is already sending or sent. Cancel the previous draft before presenting a revised one; do not claim cancellation unless this succeeds.

callId.description: Exact approvalId of the unsent native email draft to cancel.

tools.title: Cancel email draft

outputSchema.description: Cancellation acknowledgement for an unsent native email draft.

status.description: Draft is cancelled, including repeated cancellation.

tools.name: fleet_draft_email
tools.description: Show a native email draft in chat for user review. This NEVER sends. Discover the exact GMAIL_SEND_EMAIL schema first, then supply the connected account, recipients, subject and plain-text body as arguments. Requires a verified connected sender identity. HTML and unsupported providers must use a provider draft-creation action instead. The user can click Send; wait for its exact approval before executing. Do not repeat the draft as prose.
